study: Li et al. (2025), Peat Depth and Carbon Storage of the Hudson Bay Lowlands, Canada
geographic_context: Regional: Hudson Bay Lowlands, including the Hudson and James Bay lowlands; use the actual study footprint/mask, not entire bay watersheds.
native_asset_grid: Pending runtime inspection; 30 m does not establish independent 30 m detail in every input covariate.
depth_basis: Variable, modelled peat-column depth at each pixel. Carbon stock is not a fixed 0–30, 0–100 or 0–200 cm product.

study_units.imported_asset_encoding: Unverified; names alone do not establish scaling/NoData.

uncertainty: Paper describes +/-1 SD of base-model estimates (model disagreement), with additional error sources not fully represented. Verify each imported uncertainty raster's encoding and correspondence to archived files; do not label as a 90%/95% confidence interval.

predictive_evidence.context: Regional peat-depth model, not a national SOC model
predictive_evidence.examples: Distance to coastline, elevation, Sentinel-1 VH/VV ratio
predictive_evidence.complete_feature_manifest: 16 final covariates reported; Table S1 definitions, native resolutions, dates and extraction supports remain to catalogue.

ground_data_access: Paper links public validation peat depths through Borealis; training peat depths require an Ontario Ministry of Natural Resources data-sharing agreement. Do not present training data as openly hosted.
execution_status: Four source IDs supplied by maintainer. Copies and runtime access not yet confirmed. Existing 16-asset manifest remains a separate completed batch.
